headline: Interswitch Kenya Calls for Industry Collaboration to Combat Digital Fraud
summary: Financial institutions, fintechs, and the Central Bank of Kenya convened in Nairobi to address rising digital payment fraud and AI-driven threats.

impacts.name: Kenyan Financial Sector
impacts.why: Collaborative fraud initiatives involve payment providers and banking institutions across the region.
